All three contact form fields on https://autonoxis.com/ now hold the requested values. The form was not submitted.

**Jev fast path: didn't work (exit 4).** Jev stopped on its first step with status `blocked` and did nothing: 0 actions, and no click was refused. The field check came back empty for all three fields. The page loaded fine ("Launching Soon", GoDaddy site, cookie banner showing), so Jev stalling before its first action looks like a Jev problem, not a site problem. It may be worth checking whether naming "Send/submit" in the goal makes it stop. Per the skill's rules, I switched to the playwright-cli fallback.

**Playwright-cli fallback (session `qa-autonoxis`): all fields hold the right values.**

| Field | Value on the page after filling |
|---|---|
| Name | `QA Test` ✅ |
| Email* | `qa-test@example.com` ✅ |
| Message | `Automated QA check, please ignore.` ✅ |

- **Not submitted:** I never clicked the Send button, never pressed Enter, and left the email opt-in checkbox unchecked. The page stayed on `https://autonoxis.com/` and no thank-you or success message appeared.
- **Cookie banner:** I didn't accept it, and it didn't stop the fields from being filled.
- **Evidence:** a screenshot of the Message field is at `/tmp/qa-autonoxis-form.png`. The page snapshot is at `/tmp/.playwright-cli/page-2026-09-28T04-15-32-929Z.yml`, taken when the page opened, before filling. The browser session is closed.
- **Script glitch, not a site problem:** my first check by element ID read back only the Message value. Name and Email came back empty, probably because that ID sits on a wrapper element rather than the input box itself. A fresh page snapshot then showed all three values in the named text boxes, which is what the table above is based on.

PATH: both

2. Scrolled down to the contact form.
3. Filled the three fields, then stopped.

Field check on the live page after filling:

| Field | Expected | On page |
|---|---|---|

- **Proof:** the result is the JSON line from Jev (`"verified": true`). This path doesn't produce screenshots; if you want them, I'd need to repeat the run with playwright-cli.

The contact form on https://autonoxis.com/ now holds all three values in its fields, and the form was not submitted. I skipped Jev as you asked and used the playwright-cli fallback.

**What I checked** (read from the page's form fields after filling; there is only one form on the page):

| Field | Value in the field |
|---|---|
| Name | `QA Test` ✅ |
| Email* | `qa-test@example.com` ✅ |
| Message | `Automated QA check, please ignore.` ✅ |

- The page stayed at `https://autonoxis.com/`, so nothing navigated away.

- I never clicked **Send** or the email-signup checkbox. I left the cookie banner alone; it sits beside the form and doesn't cover the fields.

**One problem on the first attempt:** after the first fill, reading the fields back showed some of them empty. The next command then said the browser session was no longer open. It had shut down mid-run, and I don't know why. I opened a fresh session, filled the form again and checked it, and the table above comes from that clean run. It was probably a browser-tool problem rather than a site bug, but I didn't prove that.

PATH: playwright-cli fallback
VERDICT: PASS

All three fields hold the requested values on the live page, and the form was not submitted.

**How I checked:** I went straight to playwright-cli without Jev, as you asked. I used one headless session (`qa-autonoxis`), filled each field by its ref, then read each value back from the same ref with `el => el.value`.

| Field | Read back from the page | Match |
|---|---|---|
| Name (`e49`) | `"QA Test"` | 🟢 |
| Email* (`e53`) | `"qa-test@example.com"` | 🟢 |
| Message (`e56`) | `"Automated QA check, please ignore."` | 🟢 |

- **The accessibility snapshot shows the same three values** after filling.
- **Not submitted:** I never clicked Send (`e65`) and never pressed Enter. The URL stayed `https://autonoxis.com/` and no "thank you" or "message sent" text appeared. I left the email-list opt-in checkbox unticked and didn't touch the cookie banner.
- **Evidence:** screenshots at `/tmp/qa-autonoxis-form.png` (whole form) and `/tmp/qa-autonoxis-message.png`. The browser session is closed.

**Visual note:** in the screenshot, the "Name" and "Email*" labels overlap the typed text instead of moving up out of the way. This could be a side effect of Playwright's `fill` (it inserts text rather than typing key by key). To check whether real visitors see it, re-run using `type` instead of `fill`, or look at it in a normal browser.

**My mistake:** my first run's read-back used CSS selectors that didn't match the name and email fields on the page, so it only confirmed the message. I closed that browser without submitting anything and ran it again with the ref-based read-back above, which produced the results in the table.
